markdown_sections.title: Doom Term v1.1.4
markdown_sections.markdown: Antigravity now reports Context, five-hour Usage, working state, and diff counts to the status plate, over SSH and in local panes; setup is in docs/doom-term/remote-agent-status.md. The agent queue lists every agent pane by its pane name, and clicking a row focuses that pane. The status plate compacts at narrow widths and always keeps its right border. A tab can be dragged out of the window into a new one. The application icon is redrawn as pixel art.

markdown_sections.title: Manual installation
markdown_sections.markdown: Doom Term does not check for or install updates automatically. Install a newer package manually after saving your work and closing the application. Release notes are bundled with each build.
